comment: The assetDiffs block of a post-Glamsterdam wallet_prepareCalls on Ethereum Sepolia (11155111 = 0xaa36a7). The 0xff..fe entry is the real EIP-7708 Transfer log: type erc20, no symbol and no decimals, because 0xff..fe has no code so the relay's decimals()/symbol()/name() multicall reverts. It duplicates the native entry above it, which the relay synthesises from 0xee..ee. Shape and reasoning: celo-harness/evidence/2026-10-06-eip7708-asset-diff-proposal.md
